Verified by its reporter (qa-verifier, re-gate round 1). Same candidate and clone as above. Owner backend-workflow-engineer (T-DG5-BE-RG1); fix_revision 1e6a545e96f31160fa15d8408072d18cb0221b93 is an ancestor of edbf5ce (03-findings-fix-ancestry.log). The fix compares every row with the jobs response the SCREEN itself loaded, and brackets that snapshot between the test's own API reads before and after it (the same jobs; each value within [before, after]). QA_A22_CROSS_BOUNDARY=1 waits after the first read until a quarter hour has passed. My round-1 failure was a */15 boundary between the test's read and the screen's read. With the boundary forced, A22 passes in chromium-en and chromium-ar in both locale settings: unset 17:12:58Z read, screen after 17:15:03Z, approval.escalation_scan 17:15Z -> 17:30Z; C.UTF-8 17:39:32Z read, 17:45Z -> 18:00Z. Each time the run proves the boundary was crossed and the screen still matched. A22 also passes normally in both root runs (en and ar). The fix is not a weakening: in a disposable build where the jobs screen shows a next run one quarter early (mutant M1), A22 fails at 'approval.escalation_scan: next run' (expected data-next-run 2026-10-24T18:45:00.000Z, found 0). The non-admin 403 clause is unchanged (dev.auditor and dev.lead: API 403 and the no-permission screen).
